column1: # derivation: §7.2: concat skips NULL arguments and is never NULL;
# concat(NULL, NULL) is ''. concat(s, t) by row: 1 "abc" + "x"; 2 t NULL,
# so s alone; 3 s + '' is s ('' is a value, §7.12, and adds no bytes); 4
# U+00DF "e" + U+00C4 U+00D6; 8 NULL + NULL is ''; 9 U+1F600 + U+FF21.
# Rows 5 and 8 are the empty string, not \N.
# Types: a string (§7.2); §8 has no row for CONCAT, so nullable by §8's
# default, which is sound for a result that is never NULL; id as scanned.
